extDescription.message: A modern Lichess: a roomy layout, playful pages, your own board, pieces and sounds, and a Debrief for every game.

sidebarCollapse.description: The sidebar's toggle, while it shows its labels.

puzzleMenu.description: The puzzle page's cog, which opens the puzzle's details, its theme and the settings.

settingsLink.description: The account menu's link to the extension's settings.

nameBody.description: Under the title of the Name card.

nameSave.description: The Name card's button that keeps the name typed.

settingsPageExperimental.description: The settings' tab for the features still being tried out.

coachPickTitle.description: The title of the settings' coach page.

coachPickHello.message: Hi, I'm $1! Let's get better at chess together.

coachGhost.description: A coach's name: a little ghost.

coachCactus.description: A coach's name: a cactus in its pot.

coachToast.description: A coach's name: a slice of toast.

coachKing.description: A coach's name: a chess king.

coachQueen.description: A coach's name: a chess queen.

coachDragon.description: A coach's name: a little dragon.

coachCloud.description: A coach's name: a little cloud.

coachSlime.description: A coach's name: a drop of slime.

settingUiSounds.description: The setting that turns the extension's interface sounds on and off.

settingCoachMotion.description: The setting that plays the coaches as 3D mascots, or keeps them still pictures.

settingCoachBoard.description: The setting that has the coach draw its explanations on the board, or not.

settingCoachBoardBody.message: When the coach explains a move, it also shows it on the board, such as a passed pawn’s square for the rule of the square. Off, it only says it.
settingCoachBoardBody.description: What the coach's drawings setting covers.

packsBeta.description: The badge beside the Packs card's title: importing packs is still new.

themeGrove.description: A color theme in forest greens.

schemeToggleToLight.description: The sidebar's light / dark switch, while the page is dark.

themeFjord.description: A color theme in cold steel blues.

editorDeleteConfirm.description: The delete button, after a first click.

settingNavigation.description: The setting of where the site's navigation sits on a wide window.

settingNavigationBody.message: Where the site's menu sits on a wide window: a sidebar on the left, with the pages of the section on show listed under it or not, a rail of icons, or a header across the top.

navigationSidebar.description: The navigation as a sidebar on the left.

navigationUnfolded.description: The navigation as a sidebar listing the pages of the section on show.

navigationHeader.description: The navigation as a header across the top.

settingSidebarRatingBody.description: What the sidebar rating setting covers.

settingChesscomStudyOpen.description: The study card's link to the study's own page.

lichessRatingTip.description: The tooltip of a rating shown as on Chess.com; $1 is its Lichess rating.

settingGameIntro.description: The setting of the players' intro at the start of a game.

settingGameIntroBody.description: What the game intro setting covers.

introOff.description: No intro at the start of a game.

introSalute.description: An intro: the two players' avatars meet on the board and high-five.

introCredits.description: An intro: the players' names cross the board, as a film's credits.

streamersOffline.description: The streamers' page: the title of the others.

racerStepCombo.description: How a race goes: the combo bar.

medalStreak.description: The medal for the best Puzzle Streak score.

backupSummary.description: What the picked file is: $1 is when it was made.

backupSummaryPacks.description: The packs the picked file holds: $1 is their names.

backupRestore.description: The button that puts the picked file's settings in place of the current ones.

backupCancel.description: The button that drops the picked file.

backupInvalid.message: This file isn't a Lichess Neo backup.
backupInvalid.description: Shown when the picked file can't be read as a backup.

backupRestoreFailed.message: The settings could not be saved: try again.

roundPanelMoves.description: The game panel's tab that shows the move list.

roundPanelGame.description: The game panel's tab that shows the game's info, where the game has no chat.

cardLive.description: The hover card's badge on a player who is streaming.

cardFide.description: The hover card's FIDE rating; $1 is the rating.

cardPlayedHours.description: How long the player has played, in hours; $1 is the number.

cardPlayedMinutes.description: How long the player has played, under an hour; $1 is the number of minutes.

cardTop.description: Where their rating stands among that speed's players; $1 is a percentage.

cardHighest.description: The highest they ever reached in that rating; $1 is the rating.

cardOpponents.description: The average rating of their opponents in that speed; $1 is the rating.

cardWinShare.description: The share of their games won; $1 is a percentage.

cardDrawShare.description: The share of their games drawn; $1 is a percentage.

cardLossShare.description: The share of their games lost; $1 is a percentage.

cardStreak.description: The winning streak they are on; $1 is how many games.

cardBeat.description: Their best win: $1 is the opponent's name, $2 that opponent's rating.

zenExit.description: In Zen mode, the label of Lichess's Zen mode button, which leaves it.
